1.g3 e5 2.Nh3 d5 3.f4.strategy: Challenges the e5-pawn at once, the knight on h3 supporting the advance, and so gives the rim knight a job. It is an eccentric, committal plan that loosens White's own structure; Black's central pawns are strong enough to meet it.
1.g3 e5 2.Nh3 d5 3.f4.name: Amar Opening: Paris Gambit

1.g3 e5 2.Nh3 d5 3.f4 Bxh3.strategy: Removes the knight and drags White's bishop off the long diagonal, since the bishop on g2 is the only piece that can recapture. Black gives up the light-squared bishop for it but keeps the strong centre.
